description: This file defines the interface for the 'CompositeInput' plugin class within the WPEFramework. It declares methods for managing composite input devices, handling events, and JSONRPC communication, along with relevant includes and namespace organization.

classes.name: CompositeInput
classes.description: A plugin class for managing composite input devices and events, implementing PluginHost::IPlugin and PluginHost::JSONRPC.

methods.name: getCompositeInputDevicesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve information about connected composite input devices.

methods.name: startCompositeInput
methods.description: Starts the composite input processing or device.

methods.name: stopCompositeInput
methods.description: Stops the composite input processing or device.

methods.name: setVideoRectangleWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to set the video rectangle parameters.

methods.name: getCompositeInputDevices
methods.description: Returns a JsonArray of current composite input devices.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the position and size of the video rectangle.

methods.name: compositeInputHotplug
methods.description: Handles hotplug events for composite input devices.

methods.name: compositeInputSignalChange
methods.description: Handles signal change events for composite input ports.

methods.name: compositeInputStatusChange
methods.description: Handles status change events for composite input ports.

methods.name: compositeInputVideoModeUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to the video mode of a specified port.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string with information about the plugin.
